general.ayuda_texto: Choose a received value and describe your proposal. Preparing it does not establish that it can be corrected. Reviewing the draft checks your authorised history again. The draft is cleared when you leave or refresh the history.
general.invalido: Check the highlighted fields. The draft has not been submitted.
general.comprobando: Checking access and the service revision again…
general.sin_presentar: Submission is not available yet. This draft has not been sent or registered.
general.revision_sustituida: The service revision has changed. The draft has been cleared. Check the history and prepare a new review.

errores.dias: Enter a whole number of days, zero or greater.
errores.estado: Select a status from the list.
errores.clase: Enter a class of up to 300 characters, without line breaks or control characters.
